queries_run: United Rentals market share gaining Herc Sunbelt competitors 2026
equipment rental new entrant OR consolidation threat United Rentals 2026

findings.claim: URI 2025 年北美市占約 15%，與 2024 年底相比無重大變化（份額持平）。
findings.excerpt: Our estimated North American market share of approximately 15 percent as of December 31, 2025, which is based on industry estimates (excluding party and event rentals) from the American Rental Association (“ARA”), did not change materially from our market share as of December 31, 2024.

findings.claim: 10-K 描述產業高度分散、競爭者含小型獨立業者、區域業者、全國性公司及設備廠商／經銷商；URI 自述相對市占小可能不利於抑制租金價格壓力。
findings.excerpt: The fragmented nature of the industry and our relatively small market share, however, may adversely impact our ability to mitigate rental rate pressure.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子承認過去競爭壓力曾造成市占或價格下降，未來可能再發生，並可能遇到新競爭者。
findings.excerpt: We may in the future encounter increased competition from our existing competitors or from new competitors.

findings.claim: 某 2026 年 2 月分析稿估計 URI 北美份額約 15%，次大對手 Sunbelt 約 11–13%（來源間數字不一，無跨期比較）。
findings.source: Finterra／FinancialContent：United Rentals (URI): The Industrial Titan Navigating a New Economic Normal
findings.excerpt: URI holds a 15% market share in North America. Its nearest rival, Sunbelt Rentals—owned by Ashtead Group (LSE: AHT)—holds approximately 11-13%.

note: 未查到明確的新進入者或替代供應商搶單的 2026 來源；未查到 URI 相對 Herc／Sunbelt 的份額消長跨期比較。
